enforcement.title: Enforcement by rule
enforcement.intro: Every action the platform took under one of its rules, counted from the statements of reasons it sent. Channel moderators' own actions are not included. Any figure under 10 is hidden so no one can be picked out. Figures run to the start of today (UTC).
enforcement.window.label: Report period
enforcement.loadFailed: The enforcement report could not be loaded. Try again later.
enforcement.empty: No platform actions in this period
enforcement.emptyHint: Nothing was restricted, labelled, removed or suspended under the rules in the period you picked.
enforcement.suppressedHint: Fewer than 10: hidden so no one can be picked out
enforcement.ncii.title: Intimate-image removal requests
enforcement.ncii.intro: Each request must be acted on within 48 hours. Requests are counted in the period their deadline falls in.
